**Relevant information:**
- Item 2 (2023-05-25): The user said they had switched to a darker roast and cut back to just one cup in the morning. This is a decrease, to one cup.
- Item 1 (2023-05-26): The user said they were thinking of changing their morning coffee limit to two cups. This is an increase from one cup.

**Reasoning:**
The 2023-05-26 message is the later of the two. It shows the user considering a move from one cup to two. They only said they were "thinking of" it, so the change may not have been finalized. It is still the most recent statement about their coffee limit, and it points toward an increase. The earlier decrease to one cup came on 2023-05-25.

**Answer:** Your most recent change was an increase. After cutting back to one cup on May 25, you said on May 26 that you were thinking of raising your morning limit to two cups.
